capabilities: Chat with local or online LLMs
Answer questions from vault documents and the internet
Create custom AI agents with personas and tools
Automate research with newsletters and notifications
disambiguation: Not just a chat client; it indexes and searches your vault to ground AI answers in your own documents.
extras: The README is a general product page for the Khoj app rather than Obsidian-specific setup instructions; detailed docs, feature list and self-hosting guide are linked elsewhere. Offers both a free cloud app and paid enterprise options.
intentEvidence: Khoj is a personal AI app to extend your capabilities.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to query your notes conversationally with AI models or search them semantically.
summary: AI assistant that chats with local or online LLMs and answers questions using your notes and documents via semantic search.
